answer.says: The next cup is on the stove, and my house is indeed a little large. I accept the hospitality of the system of needs, even if I have not yet paid the bill for the last one.
answer.thought: Sunil's economy is efficient; he does not count the coin, only the habit. I drink. The steam rises again. I have walked enough for the day, and the heat is breaking. It is time to return to the bungalow and attempt to write to Lindner before the dark takes the light from the desk.
